title: Measuring Public Interest Threshold and Maintaining Public Trust under Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA) Framework
what_it_is: Measuring Public Interest Threshold and Maintaining Public Trust under Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA) Framework

sections.label: POFMA Correction Directions falsehoods
sections.summary: Four Ministries issued POFMA Correction Directions against false statements on public funds, Police powers and discrimination against citizens.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In recent weeks, four Government Ministries have issued Correction Directions under POFMA to address false statements of fact made by various parties about issues of fundamental importance to Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The falsehoods allege that the Government mismanaged public funds, abused Police powers and discriminated against Singaporean citizens in favour of foreigners.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Failing to deal decisively with such falsehoods will erode and even undermine public trust in our institutions, with serious consequences for our democracy.

sections.label: Minister ascertaining falsehood and public interest
sections.summary: In each case the Minister, advised by officials, had to ascertain a falsehood under existing law and be satisfied of a public interest requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In each and every case, the Minister, advised by his officials, has had to ascertain that there was a falsehood in accordance with our existing law.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Second, he or she has had to be satisfied that there is a public interest requirement.

sections.label: Monitoring resources and proportionality
sections.summary: Monitoring is tracked but resources limit policing; four or five POFMA cases are proportional if numbers run into thousands.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We do track but I do not think we have the resources to go around policing this in great degree.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But I would add, if indeed the numbers are anything like what the Member has cited for Thailand, if it runs into thousands, then four or five POFMA cases are, I think, quite proportional and not at all far-reaching.

sections.label: Monitoring effort and egregious cases
sections.summary: There is some effort to monitor, relying on reports and agency assessment, primarily targeting egregious cases that pop up naturally.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But having said that, I think the key point here is first, do we monitor?

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But, yes, there is some effort to monitor because we have to ensure that having set out this legislation and its intent, we do follow it through in practice.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: If you take, for example, things to do with online gambling and so on, we try to do some pre-emptive, but we also have to rely sometimes on reports or inputs coming in, and our POFMA Office people, combined with several other agencies, make the assessment and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, the answer is yes, there is some effort to monitor.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But primarily, we are looking at those cases which are egregious, and those that are egregious will pop up quite naturally and we know what they are and we can deal with it.

sections.label: No targeting, response targeted proportional
sections.summary: The response is not aimed at certain types of people or organisations, and will be targeted and proportional.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: If the Member's point is, are we only training our sights on certain types of people or organisations, the answer is no.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Member can actually see that from the kind of actions that are being taken.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And, as I have said and I am prepared to restate this, which is, our response will be targeted and proportional.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We have to look at it in the context of all that we have described and we have to take appropriate action.
